svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Dio interceptor chain · single-flight token rotation · typed error mapping · FeatureState machine · REST surface /api/v1
A · One request through the Dio interceptor chain
AppConfig.enableLogging → talker logs every failed call
Executer maps the result to a Status for the cubit
refresh fails → storage.clear() · onSessionExpired() → guest mode
the server's detail text wins over the fallback
enum Status { initial, loading, loaded, failed }
abstract class FeatureState extends Equatable { status, error }
views never touch Dio · cubits never build requests · repos return models
every screen renders loading, loaded and failed (Try again)
Equatable props → BlocBuilder rebuilds only on real change
E · REST surface used by the app (/api/v1)
JWT bearer · JSON · same API as the web app
